criteria.text: The participant has a pre-operative imaging (CT, MR, or PET scan) available in digital format.

source.text: All patients must have a pre-operative imaging (CT, MR, or PET scan) available in digital format.

criteria.text: Age is greater than or equal to 18 years.

source.text: Age greater than or equal to 18 years.

criteria.text: The participant does not have a serious concurrent medical illness that would preclude making a rational informed decision on participation.

source.text: No serious concurrent medical illness that would preclude the patient from making a rational informed decision on participation.

criteria.text: The participant has the ability to understand and willingness to sign a written informed consent form, and to comply with the protocol.

source.text: The ability to understand and willingness to sign a written informed consent form, and to comply with the protocol.

criteria.text: The participant is undergoing an image-guided surgical or interventional radiology procedure such as an angiography or a CT/ US-guided biopsy as clinically indicated or IRB-approved under a separate research protocol.

source.text: All patients in non-prostate biopsy cohorts, must be undergoing an image-guided surgical or interventional radiology procedure such as an angiography or a CT/ US-guided biopsy as clinically indicated or IRB-approved under a separate research protocol.

criteria.text: The participant has undergone a prostate MRI and has had abnormalities identified.

source.text: Patients are eligible if they have undergone a prostate MRI and have had abnormalities identified as follows:

criteria.text: The participant has PSA >2.5 OR an abnormal digital rectal exam OR an abnormality identified on prostate MRI with a clinical indication for fusion biopsy.

source.text: PSA \>2.5 OR abnormal digital rectal exam OR an abnormality identified on prostate MRI with a clinical indication for fusion biopsy

criteria.text: The participant has a pre-biopsy prostate MRI showing targetable lesions.

source.text: Pre-biopsy prostate MRI showing targetable lesions

criteria.text: The participant has an altered mental status that precludes understanding or consenting for the biopsy procedure.

source.text: Patients with an altered mental status that precludes understanding or consenting for the biopsy procedure will be excluded from this study.

criteria.text: The participant is unlikely able to hold reasonably still on a procedure table for the length of the procedure.

source.text: Patients unlikely able to hold reasonably still on a procedure table for the length of the procedure.

criteria.text: The participant has an inability to hold breath, if the procedure will be performed with conscious sedation, and without general anesthesia.

source.text: Inability to hold breath, if procedure will be performed with conscious sedation, and without general anesthesia.

criteria.text: The participant has pacemakers and other potentially electrically conductive implants.

source.text: Patients with pacemakers and other potentially electrically conductive implants.

criteria.text: The participant has a gross body weight above the CT table limit (606 pounds), if a CT table is used.

source.text: Gross body weight above the CT table limit (606 pounds), if CT table used.
